method:
paired effects   every cell runs the same seeds (common random numbers: demand, landings and operations streams,
                   and the comms start year 2028 + seed mod 4), so an effect is the mean of the per-seed differences
                   cell - reference over the seeds where both are finite, with a Student-t 95 % interval (n - 1 dof).
  law              per autonomy mix, urgent p90 (and mean) delay against relay coverage p on stage A (p = 0 is DTE
                   only), fitted to the cell means in log space (the delay spans a factor ~30) with three forms,
                   hyperbolic a + b / (p + c), exponential a + b exp(-k p) and power b (p + c)^-g; the form with the
                   lower 5-fold cross-validated RMSE of log delay (folds of seeds, the held-out fold's cell means
                   scored) is kept. Parameters, f(1) and the coverage reaching 2x and 1.5x f(1) carry percentile
                   bootstrap intervals over seeds (seeds resampled with replacement); the same coverages are also read
                   model-free off the measured cells (target = ratio x the p = 1 cell).
  break-even       at p = 0.5 (stage B): the coverage on the strict curve whose urgent p90 equals an option's measured
                   p90. The curve is model-free (the measured supervised-strict cells: non-increasing envelope,
                   log-linear between grid points), because no smooth form fits the slow decline between p = 0.2 and 1
                   well enough to invert there; the fitted law's answer is kept as p_equiv_law. The same seed draw for
                   curve and option in each bootstrap resample; "beyond full coverage" (inf) when the option beats the
                   p = 1 cell. One LTV = the engine's capital per year (VEHICLE_CLASSES['LTV'].unit_cost_musd /
                   life_years).
  operators        linked operator demand: peak = operator_peak_demand (largest hourly mean of concurrent linked
                   demand), mean = operator_hours / horizon (operator_hours counts linked demand-hours only); a cell
                   is flagged when its peak exceeds n_operators in any seed. The compression is read against relay
                   coverage 1.0 (operations identical to 'always', but demand booked the linked modes' way).
  throughput       the demand model's cargo by destination (each seed's own demand stream, from the supervised-strict
                   "always" run) against the Earth-link file: destinations that never see Earth under DTE cannot be
                   served by a rover that needs a link, so the cargo ready for them in the year bounds the DTE loss.
  round 2: medians, paired log-ratios (geometric-mean ratio, t interval on the log scale) and Wilcoxon signed-rank p beside every paired effect; cell intervals Student-t; the break-even keeps every bootstrap draw (2,000); year-blocked intervals for the primary comparisons; intervals are per comparison, not adjusted for multiplicity.

throughput_split.note: bulk = regolith flows (the demand model); landed = lander cargo (not bulk, not return); return = items sent back to the pads

laws.note: descriptive only: the three families cannot represent the slow decline between p = 0.2 and 1 (referee S5); use the model-free coverages (p_2x_cells, p_1.5x_cells)

breakeven_delay.curve: model-free: the measured supervised-strict Stage A cells (non-increasing envelope, log-linear between grid points; round 2 has levels 0.05, 0.6 and 0.7)
breakeven_delay.at: p = 0.5, supervised-strict fleet, this demand (referee O5)

bounded.design: Stage F (B-57), all-supervised fleet, 20 seeds, E21 year rule, common random numbers with Stage A: strategic+bound at bound_h {24, 72, 168, 720} x never-linked samples {refused, left out (as strategic)}, and strategic with stranding on never-linked samples, at DTE, relay 0.1 and 0.5; paired against Stage A strategic and look-ahead at the same link regime

filter_before_cap.rule: lunarsim.dispatch.marketplace caps its auction at MAX_POOL items after sorting by (priority, t_ready); the only comms filter before the cap is CommsModel.filter_candidates (engine._dispatch), which runs when every vehicle is restricted and drops items whose delivery leg can NEVER be served (could_serve); the per-pair check that a job is blocked now (_comms_blocked: job_plan infinite) runs inside the auction, after the cap
filter_before_cap.strict: not filtered: only items whose delivery leg is never linked end to end are dropped; items blocked now (a planned link wait above the deferral limit) keep their slots
filter_before_cap.look-ahead: not filtered: only items whose delivery leg has a never-linked sample are dropped; items deferred now (a forecast intervention wait above the limit) keep their slots

all_2028_seeds.note: daily samples of the auction pool in Stage F runs (bound 24 h, never-linked as strategic, DTE) of the 2028 seeds 0, 4, 8, 12, 16; each run must reproduce its Stage F row

rescue.design: Stage G (B-59): plain strategic, all-supervised, DTE only, 20 seeds, E21 year rule, common random numbers with Stage A; an intervention drawn on a never-linked sample is resolved after rescue_h {0, 24, 72, 168, 720} h and the rover drives on. The helper's own time is not modelled (optimistic). Bounds: redraw (free second draw, Stage A strategic) and strand (no help, Stage F).
rescue.breakeven_method: crossing of the paired mean differences (rescue level - strict) as rescue_h grows, linear in log(1 + rescue_h) between levels; seed bootstrap with the same draw for every level and the reference; 'beyond 720 h' when it stays above 0, 'below 0 h' when it starts at or below 0

rescue_any.design: Stage G2 (B-60): as Stage G, but every strategic intervention wait longer than rescue_h ends after rescue_h (rescue_scope 'any'), never-linked or not, so the 2028 dark spot (#188) is helped too. Also paired against the Stage G level of the same rescue_h (help only where Earth never rises). The helper's own time is not modelled (optimistic).
rescue_any.breakeven_method: crossing of the paired mean differences (rescue level - strict) as rescue_h grows, linear in log(1 + rescue_h) between levels; seed bootstrap with the same draw for every level and the reference; 'beyond 720 h' when it stays above 0, 'below 0 h' when it starts at or below 0

helper.design: Stage H (B-62): Stage G2 with the helper's own time (lunarsim/comms.py 'helpers'). Plain strategic, all-supervised, DTE, 20 seeds, E21 year rule, common random numbers with Stage A. A strategic intervention wait longer than the call threshold calls a helper at BASE; it drives to the held sample's best parking point (parking-v1.json), waits there for that point's DTE link, serves S hours and drives home (first-fit booking; sent only when it ends the wait before its natural end). Dedicated helpers are extra vehicles; 'from fleet' takes one LTV out of the hauling fleet. References: strict (Stage A), strict with one extra rover (Stage B, no mast: the same vehicle count as a dedicated helper), Stage G2 at the same threshold (the ideal helper) and always-linked strategic (Stage A).
helper.g2_headline: within 5 % of the always-linked strategic tonnage in every start year (Stage G2)
